metadata.name: side_market
metadata.description: make.fun side market: per-entry YES/NO prediction markets in USDC, priced by a mass-weighted LMSR in Q64.64, with scratches, halts, a disputed resolution and void at marks

instructions.name: add_outcome
docs: The operator lists an entry, its mass split from FIELD so C never rises.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The Config's operator: pays the market's growth.

instructions.name: close_market
docs: The operator closes a settled market: surplus and fees to the house, rent to its payer.

accounts.name: market
docs: Closed, its rent to its payer.

accounts.name: rent_to
docs: rent.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PDA ["vault", market].

accounts.name: fees
docs: PDA ["fees", market].

accounts.name: house_token
docs: A token account of the Config's house: takes the surplus and the fees.

instructions.name: finalize
docs: Anyone, after the dispute delay: the proposed winner stands.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The market's vault (re-derived): D6 in the winning world is asserted from its balance.

instructions.name: halt
docs: The operator or the guardian halts an Open market, freezing its marks.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The Config's operator or guardian.

instructions.name: init_config
docs: The program's upgrade authority creates the Config at ["config"], once, with its roles,
the mint (classic SPL Token, 6 decimals), the escrow program, the dispute delay and the fee
cap.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority (its ProgramData's upgrade_authority_address); pays the
rent.

accounts.name: config
docs: PDA ["config"]: `init`, so it is created once.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The one mint every market trades in: owned by the classic Token program (Account<Mint>
refuses a Token-2022 mint by its owner), 6 decimals.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: This program's ProgramData account, ["<program id>"] under the upgradeable loader.

instructions.name: open_market
docs: The operator opens the market for `competition_id` (NONE and FIELD only), the house
depositing ceil(b ln(1/m_floor)) + 1,000 base units into its vault.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The Config's operator: pays the rent of the market, its vault and its fees account.

accounts.name: house
docs: The Config's house: deposits the seed.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The Config's mint (classic Token program only).

accounts.name: house_token
docs: The house's token account the deposit comes from.

accounts.name: market
docs: PDA ["market", competition_id]: one market per competition.

accounts.name: vault
docs: token account of the mint (instructions::create_token_account).

instructions.name: open_ticket
docs: The operator opens `wallet`'s ticket.

accounts.name: operator
docs: The Config's operator: pays the ticket's rent, after the server's eligibility check.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: PDA ["ticket", market, wallet].

instructions.name: override_result
docs: The arbiter replaces the proposed winner during the dispute delay.

instructions.name: propose
docs: The resolver proposes the winner and the result hash once trading has ended (never under
the guardian's halt).

accounts.name: escrow
docs: discriminator, competition and result are checked in check_escrow); None otherwise.

instructions.name: resume
docs: The admin (or the operator, for its own halt) resumes a Halted market.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The Config's admin, or its operator for a halt that was not the guardian's.

instructions.name: revoke_ticket
docs: The operator stops (or restores) a ticket's buys; sells are never stopped.

instructions.name: scratch_outcome
docs: The operator unwinds an entry at the AMM before lock_ts.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The market's vault (re-derived): D6 is asserted from its balance.

instructions.name: set_config
docs: The admin replaces every Config setting but the mint.

instructions.name: set_sell_until
docs: The operator sets when the competition's result becomes public (at or after lock_ts; 0
clears it): sells outside every window land until then, never past void_after.

instructions.name: set_windows
docs: The operator sets the bounty and race trading windows (0, 0 closes one).

instructions.name: settle_ticket
docs: Anyone, once Final or Void: pays a ticket to a token account its wallet owns (its
associated token account, created when missing, or any other of the mint) and closes it.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone: pays the wallet's associated token account when it is created here.

accounts.name: vault
docs: PDA ["vault", market].

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: Takes the payout: any classic token account of the market's mint the wallet owns, or the
wallet's associated token account, created here when missing (caller pays). Unused, and
never created, when the payout is 0.

accounts.name: ticket
docs: PDA ["ticket", market, wallet]: closed, its rent to its payer.

instructions.name: sweep_fees
docs: The operator sends the market's fees to the house.

accounts.name: fees
docs: PDA ["fees", market].

accounts.name: house_token
docs: A token account of the Config's house.

instructions.name: trade
docs: The wallet moves its leg on `outcome_id` by `delta` shares (+ YES, - NO), paying at most
or receiving at least `limit` base units, fee included: a buy inside a window, a sell
inside a window or whenever sells are open (before sell_until and void_after).

accounts.name: wallet
docs: The ticket's wallet: signs for its token account.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays a new leg's growth of the ticket (the operator on the server's transactions; the
wallet itself may pay, and a sell never grows the ticket).

accounts.name: vault
docs: PDA ["vault", market].

accounts.name: fees
docs: PDA ["fees", market].

accounts.name: ticket
docs: PDA ["ticket", market, wallet].

accounts.name: wallet_token
docs: The wallet's token account: pays a buy, receives a sell.

instructions.name: void_market
docs: The arbiter voids a market not yet final, or anyone an unresolved one after void_after
while no window is open: every leg is paid at its frozen mark or scratch value.

accounts.name: signer
docs: The Config's arbiter, or anyone once void_after has passed.

accounts.name: vault
docs: The market's vault (re-derived): D6 at the marks is asserted from its balance.

errors.name: NotUpgradeAuthority
errors.msg: The signer is not the program's upgrade authority

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: The signer is not the Config's admin

errors.name: UnauthorizedOperator
errors.msg: The signer is not the Config's operator

errors.name: UnauthorizedResolver
errors.msg: The signer is not the Config's resolver

errors.name: UnauthorizedArbiter
errors.msg: The signer is not the Config's arbiter

errors.name: UnauthorizedHalt
errors.msg: The signer is neither the operator nor the guardian

errors.name: UnauthorizedResume
errors.msg: The signer may not resume this market

errors.name: UnauthorizedHouse
errors.msg: The signer is not the Config's house

errors.name: InvalidConfig
errors.msg: A Config key is unset or a Config value is out of bounds

errors.name: InvalidMint
errors.msg: The mint is not a 6-decimal classic SPL Token mint

errors.name: InvalidMarketParams
errors.msg: The market's parameters are out of bounds

errors.name: InvalidStatus
errors.msg: The market's status does not allow this instruction

errors.name: InvalidWindow
errors.msg: A trading window is malformed

errors.name: TradingClosed
errors.msg: Trading is closed: no window is open

errors.name: UnknownOutcome
errors.msg: No outcome has this id

errors.name: OutcomeNotLive
errors.msg: The outcome is not live

errors.name: FieldNotTradeable
errors.msg: FIELD is never tradeable

errors.name: InvalidOutcomeId
errors.msg: Outcome ids rise from 2 and are never reused

errors.name: TooManyEntries
errors.msg: The market holds the most live entries it may

errors.name: TooManyOutcomes
errors.msg: The market holds the most outcomes it may

errors.name: MassBelowFloor
errors.msg: A mass is below the market's m_floor, or would leave FIELD below it

errors.name: NotAnEntry
errors.msg: Only an entry can be scratched

errors.name: ScratchAfterLock
errors.msg: Scratches end at lock_ts

errors.name: TicketRevoked
errors.msg: The ticket is revoked: buys are refused, sells are not

errors.name: TicketMismatch
errors.msg: The ticket belongs to another market or wallet

errors.name: ZeroDelta
errors.msg: A trade of zero shares

errors.name: CrossesZero
errors.msg: A trade may not take a position across zero: a flip is two trades

errors.name: BuyTooSmall
errors.msg: A buy must cost at least one base unit

errors.name: LimitExceeded
errors.msg: The trade pays more, or receives less, than its limit

errors.name: TooManyLegs
errors.msg: The ticket holds the most legs it may

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: A fixed-point value left its range

errors.name: MathDomain
errors.msg: A fixed-point argument is outside its domain

errors.name: Insolvent
errors.msg: The vault would hold less than the market's worst-case liability (D6)

errors.name: TradingNotEnded
errors.msg: Trading has not ended

errors.name: InvalidWinner
errors.msg: The winner must be NONE, FIELD or a live entry

errors.name: InvalidResult
errors.msg: The result hash must not be zero

errors.name: EscrowRequired
errors.msg: The market names a prize escrow: pass it

errors.name: EscrowMismatch
errors.msg: The escrow account is not the one the market names, or not the escrow program's

errors.name: EscrowNotSettled
errors.msg: The escrow is not Claimable or Closed, or holds another competition or result

errors.name: DisputeOpen
errors.msg: The dispute delay has not passed

errors.name: DisputeOver
errors.msg: The dispute delay has passed

errors.name: VoidNotYet
errors.msg: void_after has not passed: only the arbiter may void now

errors.name: TicketsOpen
errors.msg: Tickets are still open

errors.name: TokenAccountMismatch
errors.msg: The token account is not this market's mint or owner

errors.name: FeeRateTooHigh
errors.msg: The fee rate is above the Config's max_fee_rate_ppm

errors.name: PayerMismatch
errors.msg: The account is not the market's or the ticket's rent payer

errors.name: VoidWhileTrading
errors.msg: A trading window is open: only the arbiter may void now

types.name: Config
docs: The program's one Config, PDA `["config"]` (D14): its roles, the mint every market trades in
(fixed at init), the prize escrow program propose reads, the dispute delay and the fee cap.

fields.name: admin
docs: Sets the Config (set_config) and may resume any halted market.

fields.name: guardian
docs: May halt a market (only escalate): a key never on the server.

fields.name: arbiter
docs: Overrides a proposed result or voids a market before it is final.

fields.name: operator
docs: The server's key: opens markets and tickets, sets windows, lists and scratches entries,
halts and resumes, sweeps fees and closes markets.

fields.name: resolver
docs: Proposes each market's result.

fields.name: house
docs: Deposits each market's seed and takes its surplus and fees.

fields.name: mint
docs: The one mint (classic SPL Token, 6 decimals): USDC on mainnet, the house test mint on
devnet and localnet. Fixed at init_config.

fields.name: escrow_program
docs: The prize escrow program whose escrow accounts propose reads.

fields.name: min_dispute_secs
docs: D10: seconds between propose and the earliest finalize.

fields.name: max_fee_rate_ppm
docs: D5: the highest fee rate a market may open with, in ppm (at most MAX_FEE_RATE_PPM).

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zeroed room for later fields.

types.name: ConfigParams
docs: Every Config setting but the mint: init_config's and set_config's argument.

types.name: ConfigSet
docs: init_config (initialized = true) or set_config: the Config's settings after it.

types.name: FeesSwept
docs: sweep_fees.

types.name: Leg
docs: One outcome a ticket traded.

fields.name: shares
docs: Signed position: + YES, - NO.

fields.name: cost_in
docs: What the wallet paid into the leg, fees included, all time.

fields.name: proceeds_out
docs: What the leg paid the wallet, fees taken, all time.

types.name: Market
docs: One competition's market. PDA `["market", competition_id]`; its vault `["vault", market]`
and fees account `["fees", market]` are classic SPL token accounts it owns.

fields.name: halted_by_guardian
docs: The guardian halted it: only the admin resumes.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the market's rent (the operator at open): close_market returns it here.

fields.name: escrow
docs: The competition's prize escrow (prize_escrow program), or Pubkey::default() with none.

fields.name: b
docs: Liquidity, base units (math::liquidity_for).

fields.name: deposit
docs: What the house deposited at open: ceil(b L) + 1,000.

fields.name: lock_ts
docs: The competition deadline: scratches end here.

fields.name: void_after
docs: lock_ts + VOID_GRACE: from here anyone may void a market not yet proposed.

fields.name: sell_until
docs: Position-reducing trades (sells) land until this moment, the moment the competition's
result becomes public (set_sell_until); 0 = no such moment set (sells land until the market
is proposed). Never past void_after either way (sells_open).

fields.name: base
docs: The book's frame (math.rs): the reference exponent and the exact sum of the cached weights.

fields.name: no_total
docs: N: NO shares outstanding on every live outcome.

fields.name: scratch_owed
docs: F: what scratched legs are still owed.

fields.name: fees_paid
docs: Fees paid into the fees account, all time.

fields.name: tickets
docs: Tickets open (opened and not yet settled).

fields.name: last_outcome_id
docs: The highest outcome id listed (FIELD_ID until the first entry).

fields.name: winner
docs: The proposed, then final, winner.

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: When it became Final or Void.

fields.name: reserved
docs: Zeroed room for later fields.

types.name: MarketClosed
docs: close_market: the surplus and fees went to the house, the accounts closed.

fields.name: scratch_dust
docs: Unpaid scratch dust (F) left when it closed.

types.name: MarketFinalized
docs: finalize.

types.name: MarketOpened
docs: open_market: the market exists and its vault holds `deposit`.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Where a market is in its life.

types.name: MarketStatusChanged
docs: halt or resume.

types.name: MarketVoided
docs: void_market.

types.name: OpenMarketArgs
docs: open_market's settings (D2, D3, D5, D7, D10, D11).

fields.name: seed
docs: The house's seed, base units: b = floor(seed / ln(1/m_floor)), and the house deposits
ceil(b ln(1/m_floor)) + 1,000 (math::liquidity_for).

fields.name: m_floor_ppm
docs: The minimum world share, ppm, in [MIN_M_FLOOR_PPM, MAX_M_FLOOR_PPM].

fields.name: none_mass_ppm
docs: NONE's opening mass, ppm, at least m_floor; FIELD takes the rest, at least m_floor too.

fields.name: fee_rate_ppm
docs: The market's fee rate, ppm, at most the Config's max_fee_rate_ppm.

fields.name: lock_ts
docs: The competition deadline (unix seconds): scratches end here, and void_after is 14 days on.

fields.name: escrow
docs: The competition's prize escrow (owned by Config.escrow_program), or Pubkey::default():
propose then requires it Claimable or Closed on the same result.

types.name: Outcome
docs: One outcome of a market's book.

fields.name: mass_ppm
docs: Its mass in ppm: masses of the live outcomes sum to 1,000,000 exactly.

fields.name: theta
docs: ln of its mass as Q64.64, rounded so C never rises (math::theta_of_ppm, math::join).

fields.name: q
docs: Net shares: YES minus NO, base units. Frozen at its scratch for a scratched outcome; after
resolution, what the unsettled tickets still hold.

fields.name: no_shares
docs: NO shares outstanding on it (N_j).

fields.name: w
docs: Cached weight exp(x - base) (math.rs), 0 out of the book.

fields.name: yes_value
docs: A scratched outcome's YES value, or a live one's frozen YES mark (halt, void): Q0.64.

fields.name: no_value
docs: The NO counterpart of yes_value: Q0.64.

types.name: OutcomeAdded
docs: add_outcome: an entry joined, taking `mass_ppm` from FIELD.

types.name: OutcomeKind
docs: What an outcome stands for (D1).

types.name: OutcomeScratched
docs: scratch_outcome: an entry unwound at the AMM (D7).

fields.name: q
docs: Its net shares and NO shares when scratched.

fields.name: yes_value
docs: What a YES and a NO share are paid (Q0.64).

fields.name: owed
docs: What it adds to F.

types.name: OutcomeStatus
docs: Whether an outcome is in the book.

types.name: ResultProposed
docs: propose (overridden = false) or override_result (true).

types.name: SellUntilSet
docs: set_sell_until: sells outside every window land until `sell_until` (0: until the market is
proposed), never past void_after.

types.name: Ticket
docs: A wallet's position in one market (D9). PDA `["ticket", market, wallet]`, opened by the
operator after the server's eligibility check; its legs grow by realloc.

fields.name: revoked
docs: Buys refused; sells never are.

fields.name: payer
docs: Paid the ticket's rent: settle_ticket returns it here.

types.name: TicketOpened
docs: open_ticket.

types.name: TicketRevoked
docs: revoke_ticket.

types.name: TicketSettled
docs: settle_ticket: the wallet was paid and the ticket closed.

types.name: Traded
docs: trade: one leg moved by `delta` (D4).

fields.name: position
docs: The leg's position after it.

fields.name: pay
docs: What the wallet paid into the vault (a buy), before the fee.

fields.name: receive
docs: What the vault paid the wallet (a sell), the fee already taken.

fields.name: q
docs: The outcome's q and the market's N, base and sum after it.

types.name: WindowsSet
docs: set_windows: the trading windows after it.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: Seed of the Config PDA: `["config"]`.

constants.name: FEES_SEED
docs: Seed of a market's fees account, a classic SPL token account at `["fees", market]` whose
authority is the market: trade fees land there, outside the D6 invariant.

constants.name: FIELD_ID
docs: Outcome id of FIELD: an entry that was never listed wins. Never tradeable: the mass every join
takes from and every scratch returns to.

constants.name: FIRST_ENTRY_ID
docs: The first entry's outcome id; ids rise from here and are never reused.

constants.name: MARKET_SEED
docs: Seed of a Market PDA: `["market", competition_id]`, competition_id being the competition's
16-byte UUID: one market per competition.

constants.name: MAX_DISPUTE_SECS
docs: The longest dispute delay a Config accepts, in seconds: 30 days.

constants.name: MAX_FEE_RATE_PPM
docs: D5: the highest fee rate any Config may allow, in ppm (7%).

constants.name: MAX_LEGS
docs: The most legs a Ticket holds: one per tradeable outcome.

constants.name: MAX_LIVE_ENTRIES
docs: D1: the most entries live at once. A trade at 66 outcomes (64 entries, NONE, FIELD) is the
compute-unit ceiling the program's tests measure.

constants.name: MAX_M_FLOOR_PPM
docs: The largest m_floor, in ppm.

constants.name: MAX_OUTCOMES
docs: The most outcomes a market ever holds, NONE, FIELD and scratched entries included (a scratched
entry keeps its slot: its values pay its legs at settlement): 64 live entries and 30 scratched
ones. Bounded by the program's 32 KiB heap: Borsh reads a Vec of 96 Outcomes (80 bytes each in
memory) in two allocations (51, then 102 slots: 12.2 KiB), and a Ticket's 95 legs in one, so the
largest trade's market, ticket and book stay well inside it.

constants.name: MINT_DECIMALS
docs: The mint's decimals: USDC and the house test mint are both 6-dp.

constants.name: MIN_DISPUTE_SECS
docs: The shortest dispute delay a Config accepts, in seconds.

constants.name: MIN_M_FLOOR_PPM
docs: The smallest m_floor (the minimum world share), in ppm.

constants.name: NONE_ID
docs: Outcome id of NONE: no entry wins, or the prize is not awarded. Tradeable.

constants.name: TICKET_SEED
docs: Seed of a Ticket PDA: `["ticket", market, wallet]`.

constants.name: VAULT_SEED
docs: Seed of a market's vault, a classic SPL token account at `["vault", market]` whose authority
is the market.

constants.name: VOID_GRACE
docs: D11: a market not final by lock_ts + VOID_GRACE may be voided by anyone: 14 days.
